blocks.raw: <Tip>**Memory aid:** "Chord connects, verticals connect, diagonals brace." Pratt has "inward diagonals" (think Pratt ≈ inward pointing). Zero-force: **two collinear, third bye-bye**; **two non-collinear, one zero**.</Tip>
